review.reason: The mapped layout, greens, hazards, tees, and property silhouette are broadly faithful, but the small Hole 1 fairway patch lacks clear mowing stripes, and added trees intrude into the tee-to-landing corridor.

issues.detail: The small detached fairway patch between T1 and the island green reads as mostly uniform turf rather than clearly alternating edge-to-edge mowing bands.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, this mapped fairway section is difficult to distinguish from rough or another green-area patch.

issues.detail: Added tree crowns and shadows encroach on the broad corridor from T1 toward its first fairway landing area.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the tee-to-landing carry look obstructed.
